newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to lift curfew on Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Israel to lift curfew on Hebron.

text.p: Israel said it would lift on Sunday an 11-day-old curfew imposed on Palestinians in the West Bank town of Hebron.
An army spokeswoman said the curfew, imposed when violence erupted in the area on September 24, would be lifted at 4 a.m. (0200 GMT).

A second entrance Israel opened to an archaeological tunnel near a Moslem shrine in Jerusalem's Old City triggered the clashes between Israeli soldiers and Palestinian police and civilians which killed 73 people.
Peace talks between Israelis and Palestinians interrupted by the violence were set to resume on Sunday at the Erez crossing between Israel and the Gaza Strip.
Hebron, home to 100,000 Palestinians and 400 Jewish settlers, is the only large West Bank town still under Israeli occupation.
